Name: Seasonal Treehouse for Linus w Optional Recolors
Author: djbassi
Description:
[b]Description:
[/b]
After years of moving from place to place Linus has decided to permanently establish himself in Stardew Valley in a large tree! Replaces Linus' tent with a treehouse and updates his dialogue to be appropriate. Linus' house changes with the season. Should be compatible with SVE! Compatible with Eemie's Recolour and FoliageRedone.

[b]Installation:

[/b]Unzip into your Stardew mods folder so that [CP]LinusTreehouse is in it. Thats it! A config.json file will be created the first time you load into the game that can be edited to change size or recolours if you have one!

[b]Recolours:
[/b]To use a recolor version, after the config.json file has been created open it up in notepad and then edit the "Recolor" value from "None" to "Eemie" or "FoliageRedone"

[b]Size:
[/b]To change from the large or small version, open the config.json file to change the "Size" value from "small" to "large"

[b]Requirements:

[/b]Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher to work.
